summary: Boston Properties Limited Partnership filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for an offering of senior unsecured notes due in a future year. The notes will bear a to-be-determined interest rate, pay interest semi-annually, and rank equally with other unsecured senior indebtedness. The offering is underwritten by J.P. Morgan, BBVA, BNY Capital Markets, PNC, TD Securities, US Bancorp, and Wells Fargo. Proceeds are for general purposes. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special-situation event. No deal terms are stated.
